text:
제가 학생들 *상담*할 때
제일 어려운 게 뭐냐면
en: The hardest part of counseling students?
They tell me their visions and dreams.
But: "My life feels shaky right now. I'm scared."

text:
그래서 이 비전 저 비전
막 찾고 있단 말이에요
en: So they hunt for one vision, then another.

text:
그게 무엇을 찾는 건
하나도 *중요*하지 않다고
en: What you find doesn't matter at all:
that's what I want to tell them.

text:
내 삶의 어떤 환경 속에서도
힘들지만
en: so that in any situation, hard as it is,
you have a security no one can take away.

text:
그 다음에 비전도 있고
공부도 있고 뭐도 있는 거죠
en: Then come vision, studies, everything else.
So you need to go further into the gospel, into the Word.

text:
그거를 더 *바깥*으로 가서
찾아야 되는 문제가 아닙니다
en: Don't go looking for it out there.

text:
그렇게 찾으면
어떻게 되는 것 같아요?
en: If you search that way, what happens?
I have over 20 years of data, thousands of people.
They live like that their whole lives.
The worries they had in their 20s
